items.headline: Jahiem White has 141 yards rushing and 4 TDs, North Texas beats Rice 52-23
items.description: — Jahiem White had 141 yards rushing and three touchdowns, Tayven Jackson threw a touchdown pass and scored on a 6-yard run and North Texas beat Rice 52-24 on Saturday for the Mean Green's sixth consecutive win.
